replication.target_description: The cited OSF project title matches Ku_JournEnvPsych_2014_YpZZ - COS - New Data Replication - 4930. The assigned report file esw45 is no longer available (OSF API 410). Current project describes many-labs aggregation; no full primary report was obtained.

notes: Original acquisition: DOI/publisher full text inaccessible (403); Unpaywall closed with no OA locations; OpenAlex no best OA location, repository handle identified but DMU repository blocked by 403 challenge; Europe PMC no DOI match. No original statistics taken from secondary sources. Replication acquisition: https://api.osf.io/v2/files/esw45/ returned 410, requested file no longer available; node endpoints for esw45 returned 404. Reference project g6fkp title independently verified through OSF API. Current project root lists data files and analysis code, Methods and Materials lists no files, Analysis lists only ku_ml.R, and Home wiki describes aggregation of four constituent replications. No report or printed primary summary table acquired; no statistics computed from code or raw data. Replication independently assessed despite original unavailability. Blindness limitation: a general primary-paper web search unexpectedly returned a prohibited-domain search-result snippet; that site was not opened and no values or verdict from the snippet were used. All statistical values remain unverified/null.
